detail: The spec calls demo.caption('After Place order: <url>') after the click, but no keyframe shows that caption (06-step and 07-highlight show the My orders page with no caption, while the 'Opened ...' captions do render). The redirect to /user/orders is asserted with toHaveURL but appears in the recording only through the 'My orders' heading (lesson L2). The same caption is also missing from the post-submit frames of TC-01/02/05, where the Checkout heading and form identify the page. [raised by opus, sol]
